title: Raw Collection
description: Unprocessed research collection produced by Phase 0 (Research Discovery) or Phase I (Document Ingestion). Contains all discovered items before curation. Items may be duplicative, lack summaries, and have unassigned tags. Includes an audit trail of source runs.

manifest_id.description: ID of the research manifest that produced this collection (empty for document ingestion)

source_runs.description: Audit trail of each source that was queried during discovery

source_type.description: Which source type produced these items

query.description: Search query or URL that was executed

url.description: URL that was fetched (for web sources)

path.description: File path that was ingested (for local sources)

id.description: Unique item ID, prefixed by source type (e.g., 'x_2039746395100377447', 'web_a1b2c3d4', 'local_filename')

title.description: Title if available from source; may be empty for raw items

content.description: Full text content extracted from the source

date.description: Publication or creation date if available

tags.description: Tags from source (e.g., hashtags from X); may be empty

metadata.description: All source-specific fields not captured by primary fields (engagement metrics, embedded content, etc.)
